steps.content: [Illusion: Synex's Past]
Softness envelops her. The sensation is warm, like sinking into an embrace.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Where... am I?

Hella feels herself compressed into a smaller body. An infant's perspective, able to see only strands of hair swaying gently before her eyes. A chest presses close, rising and falling in quick, uneven bursts. The heartbeat thrums against her ear, alive yet terrified.

steps.speaker: Feeble Voice
steps.content: Shh... there, there, don't cry... Mommy's taking you to a place where... you won't go hungry, a better, more beautiful place...
Pain seeps into tiny bones. Without Hypercubes, Mania festers, twisting through her, warping flesh into something wrong.
A sudden commotion erupts as a team of white-coated researchers approaches. The arms around her stiffen—hesitate—then, with a shuddering resolve, lift her away.
Her body suddenly feels weightless. The warmth vanishes. Cold hands catch her, steady and unfeeling.
The infant wails. Hella strains to see, but the faces blur, the reaching hands merge into a sea of strangers. Who held her? She cannot tell.
Only a whisper of blessing lingers, carried over on the wind.

steps.speaker: Feeble Voice
steps.content: Goodbye, Synex, my child...

steps.speaker: Feeble Voice
steps.content: You must live... live on for us... live well...
[Black Screen Transition]

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Now commencing Experiment No. 819, Fusion Attempt 5.
Argh—!
The perspective shifts. When Hella regains consciousness, she finds herself trapped in an experimental chamber.
Crimson crystals pierce her torso, forcing her body into ebullition alongside Mania. Agony follows, searing, unrelenting. This time, she is no longer an infant, no longer cradled in someone's arms.
The pain erupts from her bone marrow, spreading like wildfire. Around her, the white-coated figures observe with cold, detached indifference.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: It's no use. Ordinary subjects still can't withstand rampant Mania. Without stabilization, forget achieving resonance with Ash Crystals. They won't even survive long enough to awaken as Sinners.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: What about Aurum Secretum? Didn't those <color=#fb9259>sorcery</color> suppliers say anything useful?

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Those lunatics don't give a damn about survival rates. Aurum Secretum can forcibly suppress Mania, but it won't stop the mental degradation... Whatever, it may still be worth a shot. Let's try it.
The dosage increases, igniting another explosion of Mania. This time, she hears the wet, splintering sounds of bones warping, snapping from within.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: GO TO—HELL—AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!
Her limbs hum with a chorus of fractures, life surging through her in warped, convulsive waves.

steps.speaker: Parma Researcher
steps.content: What a rare specimen... If we increase the injection dosage further, how will it affect her regenerative abilities?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No, stop... Go away...!
[Transition Back to Background - Aurum Secretum Laboratory]
Her body crumples apart. Death closes in.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: ...Still not working. Note this down: Test Subject 819, cause of death—

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Wait! Something's off...
The Aurum Secretum seeps into her flesh, melting into her marrow through ceaseless, shuddering resonance.
Mania surges through her body. Pain belongs solely to the victorious—it is the proof of survival.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I must live... and then...
[Quick Transition to Background - Surgical Lights]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I must escape... and then...
[Transition Back to Background - Aurum Secretum Laboratory]

<size=40><u>Test Subject 819, Fusion Attempt 17.</size></u>

Subject has not completely deteriorated and has begun to establish initial resonance with Aurum Secretum.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: The M-value has surpassed the threshold, but her body hasn't fully broken down. Looks like the Aurum Secretum is effective after all.

<size=40><u>Test Subject 819, Fusion Attempt 35.</size></u>

Aurum Secretum decay cycle is approximately 720 minutes.
Increasing Mania concentration in injection solution. Continue monitoring subject's condition.

steps.speaker: Synex & Hella
steps.content: Aargh...!

<size=40><u>Test Subject 819, Fusion Attempt 49.</size></u>

Subject's body showing signs of deterioration. Rate of breakdown lower than physical regeneration rate.
Experiment continues.

steps.speaker: Synex & Hella
steps.content: Ahhh...!

<size=40><u>Test Subject 819, Fusion Attempt 127.</size></u>

High-density fusion between Aurum Secretum and subject's body achieved.
Signs of deterioration are irreversible. Subject has developed a dependency on Aurum Secretum, requiring periodic fusion.

steps.speaker: Synex & Hella
steps.content: Enough... stop... torturing me...

<size=40><u>Test Subject 819, Fusion Attempt 211.</size></u>

Physical deformities on subject's body continue to intensify. Aurum Secretum resonance rate has strengthened, exceeding all historical records.
<size=40><u>Test Subject 819, Fusion Attempt 356.</size></u>
<size=50><u>Test Subject 819, Fusion Attempt 585.</size></u>

steps.speaker: Synex & Hella
steps.content: Kill me...

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Wait... She hasn't returned to the suppression state! The monitoring systems are failing! Parameters erratic—initiate containment protocols, now!

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: She's breaking loose! Cut the power! Elimin—

steps.speaker: Synex & Hella
steps.content: Kill me... or... I'LL KILL YOU!!
Mania forms into a tangible shockwave, shattering the observation wall. With her target locked and obstacles obliterated, she lunges straight for the blonde man standing at the rear of the crowd.
—Clang. Her claws freeze, trembling inches from his throat. Then, just as suddenly, Mania recedes, causing her body to gradually disintegrate.
Yet the man only chuckles. Deliberate, unhurried, he steps forward and raises his hand.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: You're dying. How unfortunate... Your end could have been so much more meaningful. But I can offer you a way out.
The Crimebrand on his knuckles ignites as raw Mania coils at his fingertips, a malevolence dwarfing every other force in the space.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Serve me. Become my instrument, and I will make you a "hero" beloved by the masses, bathed in glory beyond your wildest dreams...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: To survive, you have no other choice.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... don't! Synex!!
Synex's form continues crumbling. Hella struggles, thrashing against the inevitable, but her consciousness is already unraveling, slipping away like sand through clenched fists.
The last thing she hears before the dark swallows her is a snicker, half-mockery, half-genuine.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...Hah. To survive, my only option is to be your dog?
[Black Screen + Floating Points of Light]
Afterward, she left the research institute and roamed the world as Campbell's shadow operative, cleaning up the dirty affairs that her "master" couldn't allow to see the light of day.
She never resisted this fate. And so, the monster donned a mask, hid her tail, and—for survival's sake—became an obedient hound, a convenient tool.
Until fate came knocking at her door once more.
[Maybe use the Fraser City background image]

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: The "Cocoon"—a mysterious Apostle matrix gifted to us by the Underground, capable of achieving maximum Aurum Secretum resonance with humans while also controlling the lifeline of all who resonate with it.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Once resonance is attempted, successful or not, the bond is irreversible. There is no severing it.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Test Subject 819, <color=#fb9259>Synex</color>. You are our most exceptional specimen. It's time for you to serve our city and fulfill your purpose.
<color=#fb9259><size=44>Project BR-005</size></color>

<color=#fb9259><size=44>Utilize the Underground ██, paired with a high-Mania Sinner, to trigger BR-005.

By controlling the Sinner, our city will create the first manipulable Black Ring.</size></color>
[Find some suitable WhiteSands background image to use here]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So this is... the memory of "resonance"... the truth about Aurum Secretum Warriors...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Heh... And here I thought I had it rough... Your life's even more of a mess than mine.
"Synex" is the most successful experiment, Campbell's shadow operative, the glorious Aurum Secretum Warrior.
Also a monument upon the path, she draws hopeful souls like moths to a flame.

At the end of the chaotic memories, Hella finally sees her: Synex, standing against a torrent of shattered recollections, darkness coiling around her like living corruption—twisting, grasping, reaching.

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Our homeland... our city... swallowed by calamity... We had no choice... ran scattered like dust on the wind...

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Infection followed us... death whispered at our backs... But then, hope. Shelter. Healing. Fraser... Fraser saved us...

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Look, it's Synex... She was one of us. She'll protect us. She'll save us...

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: ...A hero! She's our hero!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...<color=#fb9259>Hero</color>? Heh, what a joke.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Mania clings to me, trying to kill me. Aurum Secretum tortures me, turning me into a monster neither human nor beast. Then they came up with this great plan. Since my clock is ticking down anyway, they might as well feed me to the Black Ring, let Fraser's pompous lords wring what Hypercubes they could from my bones.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Everyone wanted me dead... but I survived anyway.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: But... why?
There's not a trace of amusement on Synex's face. For the first time, she seems calm... almost numb.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Is the life of your <color=#fb9259>hero</color> as worthless as a stray dog's?
The contamination begins to spread, creeping up Synex's body. But she doesn't care at all.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...?! Hey, you jerk! Don't go—where are you going?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're the one who never bows down to fate, right?! The tough-as-nails fighter who doesn't back down?! I've been stuck in a lab too, and even I busted my way out! So don't tell me you can't do the same—fight back, damn it! Don't let those Fraser bastards win!
Hella stretches forward, fingers straining, but Synex's just out of reach.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'll help you—hey! Don't you dare give up! Get your ass back here!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Give up?
The chaos suddenly stills. Then, the very space around Synex shudders, twisting violently.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, please. As if I'd let my end come somewhere this pathetic.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Mania's been rotting through me for years. If I'm going out, I'm taking everything I can with me—

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Since you're all so eager to send me to hell, you'd better pack a bag. Because we're going together!
